laws.statement: Refusal or a pre-COMMIT fault preserves stock, GL, history, outbox and receipt state.
Quantity, StockEvents and fold deltas agree; signed stock GL equals the rounded partition value delta and every journal balances.
Identical intent replays once; conflicting payload or pins refuse unchanged; lost acknowledgement cannot duplicate publication.
Complete partition and manifest fences cover empty partitions and concurrent posting; immutable replay reproduces allocations and state.
Only the pinned declared rule produces protected outputs; specialization cannot weaken inherited laws or lifecycle obligations.
Issues consume oldest stock layers; final consumption takes the residual value.
Moving-average issues use exact half-up rounding at scale six; final depletion takes all remaining value.
Returns use original issue cost, cap cumulative quantity and value, and take the residual on final return.
Cancellation appends an exact inverse once, after live dependents have been reversed.
For each metal and owner, fine input equals fine outputs plus explicitly recorded loss.
Custody metal retains its owner and cannot be sold as company stock; custody operations have no company asset or ledger effect.
A refused jewelry operation preserves all state.
Purity inputs map exactly to an integer numerator over 24000000; conflicting forms, excess precision and checked arithmetic overflow refuse.
Tenant workflows preserve named inherited core, stock and jewelry law obligations.
Consistency receipts retain the inherited law identity and origin rather than claiming a new proof.
